name: SwiftUIStudio
title: SwiftUI Studio
about: The SwiftUI module's examples as working screens: views and modifiers, stacks and grids, @State and @Binding, @Observable models, lists, navigation, tabs and sheets, forms, animation, and a first look at Liquid Glass.
notes: Demos that need their own navigation stack or tab bar open in a sheet with a Close button, so they never nest inside the lesson screen.
